# FBA: Michael Weening on the Predictability Imperative for AI


In a Fiber for Breakfast conversation with Gary Bolton, President and CEO of the Fiber Broadband Association, Calix CEO Michael Weening discusses how AI can help fiber providers move from reactive service to proactive growth—while stressing that AI must be trusted, secure, and cost-predictable to deliver real value.
